prompt.en: Turn .row into a flex container so the three .item sit on one horizontal row, spread out with space-between.

.row { background: #eaf2fb; padding: 8px; }
.item { background: #0b6fd6; color: white; padding: 16px; margin: 4px; }

prompt.en: Center the .item both horizontally and vertically inside the 200px-tall .row (justify-content and align-items both center).
